newsitem.title: CHINA: China says has 100,000 Internet subscribers.
newsitem.headline: China says has 100,000 Internet subscribers.

text.p: Some 100,000 Chinese have signed on to the Internet since China allowed the public to subscribe to the worldwide computer network in June 1995, a senior Ministry of Electronics Industry official said on Friday.

About 20,000 Chinese departments were involved in information services and more than 1,000 databases had been established nationwide, the Xinhua news agency said, quoting officials at a national electronics industry conference.
Beijing alone had 30 Internet service outlets, the ministry said.
Two public networks -- Chinanet, launched by the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, and the Golden Bridge Network set up by the Ministry of Electronics Industry -- are operating.

An increasing number of Chinese departments and network companies were developing information networks in Chinese and planned to incorporate them with the Internet through China's six international Internet outlets, it said.
